verdicts.text: Enforced course-completion criteria: all content plus a 70% test score; entry gating is not shown.
Enforced completion order: a module remains locked until the selected lesson is completed or its assessment passed.
Informational authoring: instructors enter public prerequisite/readiness text; enforced admission is not shown.
Informational readiness only: Beginner level and skills are shown beside an available Watch Now action.
Beginner-friendly guidance suggests readiness; enrollment is available and the separate Pro upsell is commercial.
Publishing, availability, sign-up limits, and delayed release are shown; learning prerequisites are not observed.
The sampled metadata step has no prerequisite control or learner enforcement evidence.

reject.reason: Publishing, sign-up limits, delayed release, and audience administration do not establish learning prerequisites.
A title/description setup step without a prerequisite control cannot establish informational or enforced requirements.

takeCorrections.take: The learner modal states enforced completion criteria—watch all content and score at least 70%—but does not show access being limited.
Kajabi explicitly configures a module lock based on completion of a selected lesson; assessment completion requires passing.
Uxcel shows beginner-friendly readiness messaging and open enrollment; the Pro-membership prompt is a commercial gate, not a learning prerequisite.
Udemy asks authors for public requirements/prerequisites text, including skills, experience, tools, or equipment; the field is informational and does not prove enforced admission.

counterCandidates.reason: Shows readiness as learner-facing level and skills information while Watch Now remains available, with no observed enforcement.
